text:
alex_cs: Heads up — Arborix renewal is half-signed. Commercial terms agreed but procurement won't attach PO. Two blockers: (1) billing entity on invoice doesn't match PO (they sent Arborix Ltd vs Arborix EU S.à r.l.), (2) seat count bumped to 25 which changes discount tier. Quote: https://docsend.com/s/arborix-q3.

marta_ae: confirmed. Sales approved the additional 5 seats at the negotiated list price with tier override. We need the SOW updated to reflect 25 seats and the adjusted line-item.

henry_fin: cannot process PO until vendor code for Arborix EU exists. Our GAAP team also needs entity legal name to match tax docs. Can the customer provide company reg number?

procurement_bot: Vendor code lookup for "Arborix EU S.à r.l." returned no match. Suggest temp code request: FIN-TEMP-214.

tanya_legal: Two legal notes: (a) if seats cross tier threshold, confirm effective date of new pricing (b) add one line: "Pricing tier and discounts apply as of signature date and are non-retroactive." I can approve the amended clause.

victor_se: I'll insert Tanya's clause and regenerate the SOW. Which signer at client should I route to?

alex_cs: procurement contact is ella.procure@arborix.eu, billing contact is invoices@arborix.eu, CFO is luc@arborix.eu. Customer asked if they can sign a PO first and return SOW after — procurement insists on SOW + matching entity.

marta_ae: okay i'll generate DocuSign envelope to CFO and procurement with the updated SOW and note for PO attachment. I'll add a comment asking the customer to attach the company reg no.

henry_fin: if you can include temp code FIN-TEMP-214 in the DocuSign note that will let procurement attach PO while we create the permanent vendor. I'll need the scanned PO and reg no for vendor creation.

victor_se: DocuSign created: https://docusign.com/envelope/arb-2026-11 routed to Luc then Ella. SOW updated: seats=25, clause from Tanya added, pricing table shows tier override.

alex_cs: pinging customer now to request reg number + confirm they'll use Arborix EU entity on PO.

procurement_bot: Reminder: envelope expiration set to 14 days. Consider shorter expiration if they want same-day processing.

marta_ae: quick update — Luc viewed envelope at 1749802400, left a comment asking whether the extra seats are billed prorated for current term.

tanya_legal: response for customer: "Extra seats added mid-term will be prorated for the remainder of the billing period unless otherwise agreed in writing." paste that exact sentence in the DocuSign comments.

henry_fin: (typo) henry_fin: temp vendor code issued FIN-TEMP-214. Finance will start vendor creation once reg no + PO copy received.

alex_cs: customer replied with reg no: LU-12345678 and attached PO in DocuSign envelope. They used Arborix EU S.à r.l. Great — please proceed.

henry_fin: received PO copy at 1749804200, creating permanent vendor ENT-VEND-1102. I'll notify when vendor is live and invoice processed.

marta_ae: Luc signed at 1749804600, Ella countersigned at 1749804720. status: SOW signed, PO attached, vendor creation in progress.

alex_cs: closing checklist: - confirm permanent vendor code, - update CRM to reflect seats=25 and final ARR, - schedule onboarding slot for additional seats. Thanks team! :sparkles:
